sections.title: About Carbon
sections.intro: Carbon is a race car's dash on fine twill carbon fibre: shift lights across the top, the reading huge on a race display with a bar under it, and bar meters for the rest, in white italic numbers with a red line.

items.alt: The Carbon style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Carbon, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €2.39, once
items.text: Buy Carbon once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Carbon's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: Layouts made with Carbon
sections.intro: Drivers built these layouts in Carbon and shared them in the app's layout market, most used first. Every layout works in every style.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

items.title: Rally
items.text: Racing: a big white tacho, a rally computer's reflective LCD and a strip of small dials.

items.title: Glass
items.text: A HUD: glowing cyan arcs and thin digits floating in brackets, no round gauges.
